content.title: Colder weather is moving in | WBTW
content.text: Skip to content by: Frank Johnson Posted: Mar 12, 2026 / 04:24 PM EDT Updated: Mar 12, 2026 / 11:28 PM EDT SHARE Much colder weather is building into the Carolinas. Tonight will be mainly clear and chilly with temperatures dropping into the 30s. High pressure will bring sunshine tomorrow and Saturday. It will be much cooler tomorrow with highs in the 60s, but that is actually normal for the middle of March. Warmer weather returns on Saturday with highs in the 70s. It will stay warm on Sunday, but moisture will return ahead of the next system. We will see more clouds and the chance for showers on Sunday. A strong cold front will move through on Monday with rain and thunderstorms. We will warm into the 70s on Monday, then it will cool down. Highs will be in the 50s Tuesday and Wednesday, before returning to normal by the end of the week. Tonight, mainly clear and chilly. Lows 32 inland, 38 beaches. Tomorrow, mostly sunny and much cooler. Highs 66 inland, 64 beaches. Saturday, mostly sunny and warmer. Highs 76 inland, 72 beaches.
